about: Dates a person wrote down about the credentials a release needs. Never a credential: the npm token lives only in the NPM_TOKEN secret of the release environment. 'expires' is the day npm showed when the token was created, as YYYY-MM-DD, or null while nobody has recorded it. Read by scripts/freshness.mjs and scripts/prepare-release.mjs. See docs/releasing.md, "The token fallback".
